people.name: Ecbatana
people.line: A city in Media where a significant scroll was found.

people.name: Media
people.line: An ancient kingdom; part of the Persian Empire

translations.web: A scroll was found at Achmetha, in the palace that is in the province of Media, and in it this was written for a record:
translations.bsb: And a scroll was found in the fortress of Ecbatana, in the province of Media, with the following written on it: Memorandum:
translations.kjv: And there was found at Achmetha, in the palace that is in the province of the Medes, a roll, and therein was a record thus written:
translations.asv: And there was found at Achmetha, in the palace that is in the province of Media, a roll, and therein was thus written for a record:
